name: PR babysitter
objective: Keep one pull request moving toward merge readiness without repeatedly requiring a human to poll comments, CI, conflicts, and stale review threads.

trigger.cadence_or_event: Every 2 hours during working hours, and after requested changes or failed required checks.

intake.selection_rule: Act only on explicit blockers: unresolved review comments, failed checks, merge conflicts, or stale reviewer state.

workspace.isolation: Dedicated branch or worktree based on the PR branch.

agents.responsibility: Summarize blockers and identify the smallest actionable work item.
Patch only the explicit blocker in the isolated workspace.
Check that the diff is narrow and review comments were addressed.

gates: unresolved comments are answered or resolved
diff is scoped to the blocker

state.update_rule: Record last checked SHA, blockers, attempted fixes, verification evidence, and next action after every run.

escalation.destination: PR comment tagging the human owner

exit.success: PR is merge-ready or waiting only on human review.
exit.stop_without_success: Loop is blocked, budget is exhausted, or the next action requires human judgment.
